reasons: Grouping differs: Datadog uses avg by {container_name} (one series per container), but the candidate's bare avg(...) collapses all containers into a single series; it needs avg by (container_name).

Unit handling: the candidate applies a hard-coded constant (/ 1e7) that is not in the Datadog source, which the rules forbid. The ns-to-percent scale should be noted in notes with a documentation link, not applied in promql.

Quantity matches: container.cpu.usage.usermode (monotonic sum, ns) is the OTel counter for the user-mode CPU usage that docker.cpu.user measures, so an exact translation exists and translated is the right outcome.
Template variable $scope has no prefix and default *, so dropping it is correct.
